question: In a cyclic quadrilateral, \(\angle A=70^\circ\). What is \(\angle C\)? (Unit: degrees.)
solution: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, so \(\angle C=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\).
